name: A Warrior's Training
summary: In Goldshire, A Warrior's Training sends young warriors to Stormwind for lessons in battlefield endurance. Lyria Du Lac directs them to the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town, where veteran Harry Burlguard offers seasoned instruction.

sections.title: From Elwynn to Old Town
sections.body: After aspiring fighters show reliable command of the fundamentals against threats across Elwynn Forest, their trainers see little more for Goldshire drillmasters to teach. Lyria Du Lac sends recruits into Stormwind, toward the gritty district of Old Town. Veteran fighters gather there to share combat experience far from the royal garrison’s rigid ways.

sections.title: Lessons of the Veteran
sections.body: Harry Burlguard, an aged battle veteran, keeps his quarters at the Pig and Whistle Tavern. He tests a warrior’s mettle with tavern grit and practical stamina instead of parade-ground drills. Before teaching defensive maneuvers that help soldiers survive dangerous campaigns, Harry expects new arrivals to match his appetite for drink and face local brawlers in the tavern.

faq.answer: Lyria Du Lac, the warrior trainer behind the blacksmith in Goldshire, offers this training after a fighter proves their early combat skill.

faq.q: Where can Harry Burlguard be found?
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard can be found inside the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind City’s Old Town district.
Harry teaches practical moves and stances that help warriors endure longer in the field, beginning with tests of stamina.

faq.q: Why is training held in a tavern instead of the barracks?
faq.answer: Old Town is Stormwind’s traditional, rough heart, where retired soldiers and hardened veterans gather. Harry teaches over ale and with bare-knuckle discipline instead of the barracks’ formal military ways.

faq.q: What comes after speaking to Harry?
faq.answer: After speaking with Harry, the recruit faces a challenge involving Bartleby the Drunk, a local brawler, to test their physical resilience before training is complete.
Only warriors can receive this training. It belongs to the dedicated warrior training line.

angles.text: As a warrior, this rite marks your passage from local militia recruit to an officially recognized soldier of the Alliance. It opens the way to advanced stances and defensive techniques.
As a human fighter, your path leads from Elwynn’s pastoral defenses into Old Town, the ancestral, working-class cradle of Stormwind’s martial heritage.
As an Alliance recruit, you can carry practical brawling wisdom from veterans like Harry Burlguard toward contested borders, alongside book-learned tactics.
